update.subtitle: Version {{version}} is available on the App Store
update.description: Update now to get the latest features and fixes.

homeTab.title: The new Home tab
homeTab.desc: A Home of your own on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV: a smart hero with the titles to resume, dynamic rows, "Tonight on TV" and custom feeds. You can customise or hide the Home and turn it back on from settings

traktIntegration.title: Trakt integration
traktIntegration.desc: Connect your Trakt account: progress and watched states stay in sync, you can rate a film or an episode when you finish it, import your history and choose which playlists the integration applies to.

externalRatings.title: IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic ratings
externalRatings.desc: Film and series pages show the IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Trakt scores right in the hero. TMDB remains the primary source.

dynamicBackground.title: Dynamic background
dynamicBackground.desc: Settings > Theme has a new Background picker: Black, theme colour or Dynamic, which blends the featured poster behind the interface. Your choice syncs across devices, and on iOS the icon and widget follow it too.

setupWizard.title: Guided setup
setupWizard.desc: After your first playlist, a short walkthrough helps you set the essentials: playback profile, PIN, automatic opening. You can also copy settings from one playlist to another.

sagaNextPill.title: Sagas treated like a series
sagaNextPill.desc: The "Next" button in the player also suggests the following films in the same saga, and a collection's page has Play, Resume and Watch again just like a TV series.

tvPlaylistPeek.title: Quick playlist switching on Apple TV
tvPlaylistPeek.desc: Pressing Menu from the tab bar brings up the playlist selector before you leave: switch profile in one gesture.

aetherUpdate.title: Aether engine updated
aetherUpdate.desc: Aether engine updated to 6.75.0: it now lists every audio and subtitle track and starts VOD faster.

chromecastAirplayImprovements.title: More reliable Chromecast and AirPlay
chromecastAirplayImprovements.desc: Live channels over AirPlay now reach non-Apple TVs too. Several Chromecast bugs have been fixed.

epgSourcePicker.title: EPG source easier to find
epgSourcePicker.desc: The EPG source picker now also finds the IDs the guide doesn't declare, so more channels get the right programmes.

performance.title: More responsive
performance.desc: The Home and detail pages open faster.

playerFixes.title: Player fixes
playerFixes.desc: Language tracks are clearer, and your preferred language is applied more intelligently even when tracks have odd names; with MPV the video is pixel-aligned, no more blurry logos; closing the player during a fallback no longer leaves ghost audio; reloading a live channel keeps the engine you picked by hand.

continueWatchingFixes.title: Continue watching fixes
continueWatchingFixes.desc: The row updates right after you close the player, resume works across devices for series too, and when a new episode is out you get "Resume SxEy" instead of "Watch again".

metadataFixes.title: Metadata fixes
metadataFixes.desc: Titles with a country prefix or a trailing year now find the right metadata, and a hand-picked poster survives a restart.

arabicRtlFixes.title: Arabic fixes
arabicRtlFixes.desc: In the player the horizontal gestures, the swipe between info tabs and the seek arrows follow the right direction, with Arabic-Indic digits on the buttons.

tvosFixes.title: Apple TV fixes
tvosFixes.desc: A channel preview goes full screen without reloading it, and "Require PIN to open Settings" now takes effect.

accountFixes.title: Other fixes
accountFixes.desc: The password reset link works even without the app installed, and incognito searches are no longer saved.

headline.title: The Home has arrived.
headline.sub1: Now with Trakt, so what you watch follows you.
headline.sub2: Ratings from IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic.
headline.sub3: And a background that takes its colours from what's on screen.

aetherEngine.title: Aether, the new playback engine
aetherEngine.desc: A new video engine, now the default on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV: faster start-up, channel zapping in about a second, and full support for background, Picture in Picture, AirPlay and Chromecast.

playerNextTab.title: Next episodes right inside the player
playerNextTab.desc: The player has a new "Next" tab with the rest of the season: jump to the next episode without leaving playback.

downloadsSeasonAndOffline.title: Download a whole season, richer offline
downloadsSeasonAndOffline.desc: Download an entire season with one button and cancel all in-progress and queued downloads at once. You can now skip the intro on downloaded episodes too.

searchSagaFolders.title: Sagas become folders in search
searchSagaFolders.desc: Films from the same saga are gathered into a book-style folder in the results: open it and find every chapter in order, without hunting them down one by one.

mpvEngine.title: mpv, another playback engine
mpvEngine.desc: MPV joins the list of engines available on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV: one more option for when a stream misbehaves.

ipadCategoriesPanel.title: Categories panel on iPad in landscape
ipadCategoriesPanel.desc: With iPad in landscape, the Live TV categories stay pinned to the side, both in the channel list and in the programme guide.

UXUIImprovements.title: UX and UI improvements
UXUIImprovements.desc: The eye wants its share too, and as always attention to detail makes the difference. See for yourself.

tvosNavigationFixes.title: Navigation fixes on Apple TV
tvosNavigationFixes.desc: After picking a version the right title now opens, RIGHT past the last season no longer jumps elsewhere, and the guide cards in the column Live view are legible again.

searchFixes.title: Search fixes
searchFixes.desc: On Apple TV, search now starts only once you have really stopped typing. No more lag or slowdowns.

contentFixes.title: Content fixes
contentFixes.desc: A series now leaves Continue Watching after the last available episode and returns to the top when a new one arrives; hidden content stays hidden in the version and quality pickers too; an actor with multiple roles no longer crashes the app on Apple TV.

dolbyAtmosReliableAudio.title: Dolby Atmos, as it should be
dolbyAtmosReliableAudio.desc: KIPTV detects Dolby Atmos tracks more accurately and selects the most suitable player for Dolby Vision HLS streams, for a more reliable audio and video experience.

uxUiImprovements.title: UX/UI improvements
uxUiImprovements.desc: The built-in browser, Support Centre and numerous navigation details have been refined to make the app more pleasant to use.

providerResponseReliability.title: More reliable IPTV providers
providerResponseReliability.desc: Improved handling of incomplete or incorrect responses from IPTV providers, so the catalogue can be retrieved more reliably.

tvosSessionRestore.title: Apple TV sessions preserved
tvosSessionRestore.desc: Restoring the app no longer interrupts active sessions on Apple TV.

detailAltreVersioniLeAltre.title: Every version of a title, all in one place
detailAltreVersioniLeAltre.desc: A film or series page now has an “Other versions” section listing the other copies in your playlist, so you can pick the quality or language you prefer.

offlineProgressoSincronizzato.title: Pick up where you left off, even offline
offlineProgressoSincronizzato.desc: Your position in downloaded content is saved on the device and transferred to your account as soon as you’re back online, so you find your place on your other devices too.

liveMettiInCimaDal.title: “Pin to top” for channels and categories
liveMettiInCimaDal.desc: Press and hold a channel or a category to move it to the top of the list, so the things you watch most stay within easy reach.

playerRiproduzioneInBackgroundOpzionale.title: Background audio on Apple TV
playerRiproduzioneInBackgroundOpzionale.desc: In Settings you can choose to keep audio playing when you leave the player or send the app to the background. It’s off by default.

detailRicercaGoogleDalDettaglio.title: Search a title on Google with one tap
detailRicercaGoogleDalDettaglio.desc: Open a Google search straight from a film or series page, for reviews, cast and trivia.

rtlInterfacciaArabaSuTvos.title: Improved RTL interface on Apple TV
rtlInterfacciaArabaSuTvos.desc: With Arabic selected, menus, carousels, the TV guide and the player lay out correctly from right to left on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV.

uiRifinitureInterfaccia.title: Interface refinements
uiRifinitureInterfaccia.desc: Improved graphic details and various animations.

tvosRiordinareInGestioneContenuti.title: Reordering categories no longer freezes the app
tvosRiordinareInGestioneContenuti.desc: On Apple TV, moving categories and content in Content management stays smooth even with very large playlists.

downloadsReliableAndParallel.title: More reliable downloads, and simultaneous if you want
downloadsReliableAndParallel.desc: An interrupted download resumes on its own when you reopen the app, and failed attempts are retried automatically. You can also turn on simultaneous downloads to fetch several titles together.

downloadsLiveActivity.title: Your downloads on the Lock Screen
downloadsLiveActivity.desc: Follow download progress from the Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island, with one card for each film or series.

tvPairingViaWeb.title: Connect the TV from your phone, even without the app
tvPairingViaWeb.desc: Point the camera at the QR code: if you don't have KIPTV on your phone yet, you can sign in or register on the website and confirm the connection from there. If you do have it, the code opens straight in the app.

bulkCategoryControls.title: Show or unlock every category in one tap
bulkCategoryControls.desc: Content management now has quick commands to make all hidden categories visible again or remove the lock from the protected ones.

instantSearchLargePlaylists.title: Instant search, even with huge playlists
instantSearchLargePlaylists.desc: Results appear as you type without waiting for the network, and no longer come up empty on very large catalogues.

tvosLiveImageQuality.title: Cleaner picture on live channels
tvosLiveImageQuality.desc: On Apple TV, deinterlacing is now genuinely applied to interlaced channels, with hardware decoding still active on the rest: no more combing on movement.

contentManagementStability.title: No more unexpected quits in Content management
contentManagementStability.desc: Hiding or locking categories on very large playlists no longer closes the app.

iosLivePlayerChannelZap.title: Fast channel switching, now on iOS
iosLivePlayerChannelZap.desc: In the Live player, you can move to the previous or next channel and quickly refresh the stream.

continueWatchingLocalizedTitles.title: Localised titles in Continue Watching
continueWatchingLocalizedTitles.desc: Films and series now show the TMDB title in the app language, with more consistent information on cards.

ipadRedesign.title: Redesigned iPad experience
ipadRedesign.desc: Landscape detail with a poster panel, Settings in a split-view sidebar and a multi-column Live TV channel list: on iPad the app makes far better use of the large screen.

detailInfoFooter.title: More information about content
detailInfoFooter.desc: Movie and TV series pages now show a new panel with status, country of production, production companies and other details.

homeCardHero.title: Featured content as a card
homeCardHero.desc: At the top of Movies and TV Series you can now show the featured content in a more compact card style instead of full screen.

tvosEpgReminders.title: Programme reminders, now on Apple TV too
tvosEpgReminders.desc: Set a reminder for a programme from Apple TV and get a notification on your iPhone or iPad when it's about to start.

settingsReorg.title: Reorganised Settings
settingsReorg.desc: Settings have been reorganised into clearer sections with more options to customise the app.

widgetsEfficiency.title: More efficient Widgets and Top Shelf
widgetsEfficiency.desc: Reduced resource usage for Widgets and Top Shelf, with lighter and faster updates.

foregroundResponsiveness.title: Back to the foreground with no lag
foregroundResponsiveness.desc: Fixed a slowdown that could occur when reopening the app: it now resumes instantly and without freezes.

epgChannelColoredCards.title: Redesigned TV Guide
epgChannelColoredCards.desc: Programme cards in the channel's colours, a new header, smoother fades and improved navigation on iOS and Apple TV.

tvosChannelLogoInLive.title: More informative live player on Apple TV
tvosChannelLogoInLive.desc: The channel logo is now visible in the player, and the Info panel highlights artwork for the programme on air.

iosTabBarMinimize.title: Tab bar that minimises while you browse (iOS 26)
iosTabBarMinimize.desc: On detail screens the tab bar minimises automatically, leaving more room for your content.

subtitlesSystemEdgeStyles.title: Subtitles that match the system style
subtitlesSystemEdgeStyles.desc: In System mode, the "Raised" and "Depressed" subtitle edges now faithfully reproduce the style from your iOS settings.

myListMultiTag.title: My List: multiple tags and reordering
myListMultiTag.desc: You can now assign multiple tags to the same item and reorder them freely. Channel customisations survive renaming, and Continue Watching cards show more accurate information.

catalogLoadingPerformance.title: Faster, smoother catalogue loading
catalogLoadingPerformance.desc: The catalogue is processed in the background and navigation stays responsive while loading: no more freezes when opening very large playlists, especially on Apple TV.

tvosStabilityFixes.title: Stability and navigation on Apple TV
tvosStabilityFixes.desc: Fixed two crashes when loading content, focus getting lost after returning from the app switcher, and tab switching at content edges.

playerSmoothness.title: Smoother playback on 50 fps and/or HDR channels
playerSmoothness.desc: Removed stutters while using the player controls on Apple TV, and smoother 50 fps live playback on iPhone/iPad/Mac.

minorBugFixes.title: Minor bug fixes
minorBugFixes.desc: Fixed various stability and performance issues across the app.

UIUXImprovements.title: UI/UX improvements
UIUXImprovements.desc: Layouts and interactions have been improved for a more enjoyable user experience.

richLiveReplayInfo.title: Richer Live and Replay information
richLiveReplayInfo.desc: The Info panel now combines the EPG guide and TMDB metadata, with richer images and details for the programme airing live or in replay.

smootherPlayer.title: A smoother, more responsive player on iOS
smootherPlayer.desc: Animations, gestures and controls are smoother, with full ProMotion support on compatible devices.

epgReplayAccuracy.title: EPG and Replay stay in sync
epgReplayAccuracy.desc: The programme panel now distinguishes live, past and upcoming content more accurately, and Replay shows information for the correct programme.

minorBugFixes.title: Minor bug fixes
minorBugFixes.desc: Several bug fixes have been made to improve app stability and performance.

accountConnectedDevices.title: Connected devices
accountConnectedDevices.desc: See all the devices where you're signed in and sign them out remotely whenever you want.

recentlyWatchedLiveToggle.title: Hide recently watched channels
recentlyWatchedLiveToggle.desc: Show or hide the Live channels you've watched recently.

tvosLiveCarouselRedesign.title: Improved Live carousel view on Apple TV
tvosLiveCarouselRedesign.desc: The Live section on Apple TV has a new look in the style of Movies and Series: carousels with 16:9 previews, a full-screen backdrop, a glass programme guide and categories that expand from the sidebar.

topShelfChannelLogo.title: Correct channel logo in the Top Shelf (Apple TV)
topShelfChannelLogo.desc: The custom logo you choose for a Live channel now also appears in the Apple TV Top Shelf.

playerWhiteThemeChips.title: More readable white theme in the player
playerWhiteThemeChips.desc: With the white theme, the selected buttons among the player controls now have the right contrast.

playerPlayWithEnginePicker.title: Play straight away with your preferred player
playerPlayWithEnginePicker.desc: Choose the engine to start playback with (KSPlayer, VLC or AVPlayer) on every launch. And with Premium you can open films and channels directly in external players (VLC or Infuse).

metadataManualTmdbOverridePersonalizza.title: Customise movie and series metadata
metadataManualTmdbOverridePersonalizza.desc: When a title is matched to the wrong information, you can fix it by hand by picking the right TMDB result, or remove the match entirely.

playerOpensubtitlesAlwaysVisibleAudio.title: More control over subtitles and audio
playerOpensubtitlesAlwaysVisibleAudio.desc: Search for more subtitle options on OpenSubtitles (enable it in the OpenSubtitles settings) and adjust audio and subtitle delay. Your preferences are remembered for each item.

livetvCarouselLayoutForThe.title: New carousel layout for Live TV
livetvCarouselLayoutForThe.desc: The Live TV section can now show channels as horizontal carousels, just like Movies and Series. Choose the layout you prefer in settings.

themeWhiteTheme4thAdaptive.title: New white theme
themeWhiteTheme4thAdaptive.desc: Try the new white theme: elegant, clean and classic.

tabsNascondiSchedeFilmSerie.title: Hide empty tabs
tabsNascondiSchedeFilmSerie.desc: If a playlist has no films, series or live channels, the matching tab is hidden automatically. You can turn the option off in settings.

subtitlesSelfRenderCaptionsTo.title: Subtitles true to your style
subtitlesSelfRenderCaptionsTo.desc: Subtitles now better reflect your system settings, colour included, with any playback engine.

cwSelfHealContinueWatching.title: Continue Watching and My List heal themselves
cwSelfHealContinueWatching.desc: When your playlist provider reassigns content IDs, Continue Watching and My List entries no longer show the wrong films or artwork: they realign themselves to the updated catalogue.

epgInstantLoadViaStale.title: Faster TV guide on launch
epgInstantLoadViaStale.desc: The programme guide (EPG) now loads instantly by reusing saved data and refreshing it in the background, with no more wait of a few seconds on every open.

playerNoFalseCompletionOn.title: No false “already watched” on broken streams
playerNoFalseCompletionOn.desc: Some faulty streams made the app think a film had ended, marking it as watched or moving to the next one. This no longer happens.

playerCatchupDoubleLiveBadge.title: More reliable Catch-up/Replay
playerCatchupDoubleLiveBadge.desc: Fixed the double “LIVE” badge during catch-up, restored the audio and subtitle controls, and improved the Replay experience.

resolve9RegressionsFound.title: Stability fixes
resolve9RegressionsFound.desc: Fixed several issues found during internal testing, for a more stable and reliable app.

epgShowEpgFanartOn.title: EPG Fanart
epgShowEpgFanartOn.desc: Programmes airing on channels now show their own image taken from the EPG (if available), otherwise they fall back to TMDB or the channel logo, as before.

playerUnifiedSubtitleStylingApple.title: Customise the look of subtitles
playerUnifiedSubtitleStylingApple.desc: Choose the font, size, bold and outline of subtitles, or use Apple's system style. You can change your choice in settings or directly in the player.

playerUnifyFallbackChainTo.title: More reliable playback
playerUnifyFallbackChainTo.desc: Improved automatic player-selection algorithm on iOS and Apple TV.

epgEpgEmptyOnFirst.title: TV guide visible right at startup
epgEpgEmptyOnFirst.desc: Custom programme guides (EPG) now appear right from the first time you open the app, with no need to close and reopen it.

playerSkipIntroRecapCredits.title: Skip intro, recap and end credits
playerSkipIntroRecapCredits.desc: Skip the opening titles, the previous-episode recaps and the end credits of films and series with a single tap.

watchedMarkMoviesWholeSeries.title: Mark films and whole series as watched
watchedMarkMoviesWholeSeries.desc: Keep track of what you've already seen: posters of watched titles dim and show a tick.

iosAvatarMenuCompactIcon.title: More compact playlist menu on iOS
iosAvatarMenuCompactIcon.desc: The playlist menu has been redesigned with a handy row of quick icons that's easier to use.

settingsMoveDefaultAudioSubtitle.title: Default audio and subtitle language, live too
settingsMoveDefaultAudioSubtitle.desc: Set your preferred audio and subtitle language from a dedicated section in settings. It now applies to live channels too, not just films and series.

tvosLiveReplayNoEngine.title: Smoother live replay
tvosLiveReplayNoEngine.desc: Rewind and scrub live TV instantly, with a progress bar like the one for films and series and more reliable speed control.

playerDefaultVodToHardware.title: Smoother, more efficient films and series
playerDefaultVodToHardware.desc: In automatic mode, films and series now use hardware decoding for smoother playback and lower battery use.

playerAccurateSeekForVod.title: More precise scrubbing and ±10s skips
playerAccurateSeekForVod.desc: On films, series and catch-up with KSPlayer, scrubbing and skipping back and forth now land exactly on the right spot.

tvosLivePlayerOverhaulKsme.title: KSPlayer improved
tvosLivePlayerOverhaulKsme.desc: We completely rewrote the KSPlayer integration — it's now more optimised and smoother in every situation across movies, series and live channels.

iosNativeAirplayNowPlaying.title: AirPlay with video in any format
iosNativeAirplayNowPlaying.desc: Send video over AirPlay, not just audio, in any file format — even the most exotic.

tvosHomogeneousCustomCornerPip.title: Picture-in-Picture in every player on Apple TV
tvosHomogeneousCustomCornerPip.desc: Watch your content in a corner of the screen with any playback engine.

tvosMultiviewFromSingleIs.title: Multiview is even smoother
tvosMultiviewFromSingleIs.desc: Open several channels on the same screen and switch between them even more responsively, with no reload.

tvosKill4sDismissFreeze.title: Faster, more responsive Live TV on Apple TV
tvosKill4sDismissFreeze.desc: Removed the few-second freeze when leaving the player; channel scrolling and channel switching are smoother.

tvosHeaderClockRespectsSystem.title: The header clock follows your system's 12/24-hour format on Apple TV

tvosCwCardPlaceholderLogo.title: Fixed a placeholder logo lingering over the cover in Continue Watching

liveLogoFromEpg.title: More complete Live TV channel logos
liveLogoFromEpg.desc: When you customise a channel's logo, you can now also pick the one provided by the EPG and search for it with the new search field.

liveAutoQuality.title: “Auto” quality for live (experimental)
liveAutoQuality.desc: A new experimental option in Settings → Player automatically selects and adapts the quality of Live channels during playback. Off by default.

tvosLiveReloadFix.title: Fixed unexpected live reloads on Apple TV
tvosLiveReloadFix.desc: Fixed a bug introduced in 1.6 that caused unexpected live reloads on Apple TV.

categoryManagement.title: Rename categories
categoryManagement.desc: Rename, lock with a PIN, or hide your movie, series and channel categories by pressing and holding the category name.

liveChannelRename.title: Rename channels
liveChannelRename.desc: Give any live channel a custom name from the context menu. Rename a single version or all quality variants together: channels with the same name stay grouped.

channelCustomEpgLogo.title: Custom EPG per channel
channelCustomEpgLogo.desc: Manually pick the correct programme guide for each channel and adjust the EPG time offset.

fasterHugeEpg.title: Faster, lighter programme guide
fasterHugeEpg.desc: Very large EPG guides now load faster and use less memory.

smootherLiveTv.title: Smoother Live TV
smootherLiveTv.desc: Opening channels and browsing the guide are more responsive on iPhone and Apple TV, with automatic recovery of frozen live channels.

tvosMovieArtwork.title: Movie posters and details on Apple TV
tvosMovieArtwork.desc: On Apple TV, movie posters and details are now fetched from TMDB even when the provider doesn't supply an identifier.

tvosRecentlyAddedPosters.title: Blank posters in Recently Added on Apple TV
tvosRecentlyAddedPosters.desc: Fixed an issue where the first posters in the Recently Added section could appear blank on launch on Apple TV.

myListSync.title: My List default tags
myListSync.desc: Fixed an issue where My List default tags reappeared after reinstalling, even if they had been hidden.

tvosPinPrompt.title: PIN prompt on Apple TV
tvosPinPrompt.desc: Fixed the appearance of the parental PIN entry screen on Apple TV.

avatarPickerRenewed.title: New avatars
avatarPickerRenewed.desc: Personalise your experience by choosing from over 250 new avatars, inspired by the most iconic characters from films, series, anime and sport.

livetvPerPlaylistStartSection.title: Live TV opening category
livetvPerPlaylistStartSection.desc: Choose which channel category Live TV opens on for each playlist: the playlist's first category, your favourites or recently watched.

playerHardwareKeyboardControls.title: Hardware keyboard controls on Mac and iPad
playerHardwareKeyboardControls.desc: Play/pause, skip forward and back and other player controls now respond to the hardware keyboard on Mac and iPad.

livetvSmarterChannelGrouping.title: Smarter channel grouping
livetvSmarterChannelGrouping.desc: KIPTV recognises more variants and qualities of the same channel, with much broader compatibility across different providers.

playerSubtitleAppearanceMenu.title: Cleaner subtitle appearance menu
playerSubtitleAppearanceMenu.desc: The menu for customising subtitle appearance now shows only when an external subtitle is active.

playerAudioSubtitleTracksAllEngines.title: Audio and subtitle tracks on every player
playerAudioSubtitleTracksAllEngines.desc: Audio and subtitle tracks now appear correctly with any playback engine.

customPerCategoryOrder.title: Sort content your way, category by category
customPerCategoryOrder.desc: Set a custom content order for each Film, TV Series and Live TV category: KIPTV remembers it and always shows it just as you left it.

playlistAvatarActionsMenu.title: Quick actions from the playlist avatar
playlistAvatarActionsMenu.desc: Tap your playlist avatar to open a quick-actions menu or go to settings.

contentSettingsSplit.title: Clearer settings: Content and Parental Controls
contentSettingsSplit.desc: Content settings are now split into two dedicated sections, Content and Parental Controls, so you can find what you need straight away.

perPlaylistTrendingToggle.title: Trending toggleable per playlist
perPlaylistTrendingToggle.desc: A new option lets you choose whether to show the trending section for each playlist.

playlistCompatibility.title: Faster, more compatible playlists
playlistCompatibility.desc: M3U playlists from Xtream panels are now automatically upgraded to the native Xtream version, which is faster and includes full categories, with extended compatibility across more providers.

supportChatPolish.title: More convenient support chat
supportChatPolish.desc: Conversations open straight to the latest message, with automatic scrolling and read receipts. Notifications and badges clear correctly when you read messages.

categoryLockUsability.title: Category lock, even handier
categoryLockUsability.desc: From the Live TV grid and the programme guide you can lock or unlock entire categories with a tap, and the context menu offers to unlock when content is protected at category level.

contentAggiuntiDiRecenteSection.title: "Recently Added": discover new content instantly
contentAggiuntiDiRecenteSection.desc: A new section in Movies, Series and Live TV highlights the most recently added content in your playlist, so you can find what's new without searching.

playerMediaInfoBadgesHdr.title: HDR, Dolby Vision, 4K and FPS badges on the player
playerMediaInfoBadgesHdr.desc: During playback you can see the stream quality at a glance — HDR, Dolby Vision, 4K and frame rate — with automatic HDR mode activation. Same experience on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV.

playerPerEngineAdvancedSettings.title: Advanced settings for each engine, right in the player
playerPerEngineAdvancedSettings.desc: From the engine picker in the player you can now adjust the advanced options specific to each engine, to tailor playback to every stream.

settingsAddOptionForContent.title: Refresh content on every access
settingsAddOptionForContent.desc: A new option in settings automatically reloads your playlist content each time you open the app, so your catalogue is always up to date.

epgGzipXmltvSupportDecoupled.title: Faster, more compatible programme guide (EPG)
epgGzipXmltvSupportDecoupled.desc: Added support for compressed EPG guides (gzip), with loading decoupled from content and clearer source diagnostics.

playerTvosCutMainThreadContention.title: Smoother Live TV on Apple TV
playerTvosCutMainThreadContention.desc: Optimisations that reduce stuttering during live playback, along with several VLC engine fixes.

parentalCategoryAwareGateClose.title: Stronger parental controls, including by category
parentalCategoryAwareGateClose.desc: The PIN lock now applies correctly to entire categories and can no longer be bypassed.

epgRenderCachedEpgWhen.title: Programme guide always visible while scrolling
epgRenderCachedEpgWhen.desc: Fixed an issue where EPG information could disappear when grid rows were reused during scrolling.

premiumThemes.title: Customise KIPTV your way: premium themes on iOS and Apple TV
premiumThemes.desc: Choose your app colour and home icon from a carefully curated selection.

tvosDetailRewrite.title: Films and TV series on Apple TV: fully redesigned detail screens
tvosDetailRewrite.desc: Detail pages have been rewritten from scratch for smooth performance: cinematic transitions, instant scrolling, zero hesitation even with huge catalogues.

tagsFromAnywhere.title: Organise everything with tags, from anywhere in the app
tagsFromAnywhere.desc: Create, rename, reorder and delete your custom tags directly from the context menu of any film, series or channel.

fixMoviesTabEmptyOnSomePlaylists.title: Fixed a bug where some playlists did not show films
fixMoviesTabEmptyOnSomePlaylists.desc: On some playlists the Films section was stuck on a black screen due to provider data in unexpected formats. KIPTV now recovers and displays content correctly in these cases.

fix4kChannels.title: 4K channels: video now always starts
fix4kChannels.desc: Fixed an issue that caused some 4K channels to play audio-only when using AVPlayer/KSPlayer. Playback now works perfectly on all players.

recentSearches.title: Recent searches always at your fingertips
recentSearches.desc: Your latest searches appear at the top of the Search screen on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV: pick up where you left off with a single tap.

customChannelLogos.title: Channel logos exactly the way you like them
customChannelLogos.desc: Each channel can have its own logo: choose from a curated community library or search for one on the web. Full support for SVG and transparency.

fixThirdPartyEpgUrls.title: Programme guide (EPG) from any source, finally reliable
fixThirdPartyEpgUrls.desc: KIPTV now handles third-party EPG URLs correctly end-to-end: add your preferred programme guide and let KIPTV do the rest.

multiview.title: Multiview: 4 channels at once
multiview.desc:
Watch up to 4 Live channels simultaneously with the new Multiview experience. Expandable tiles, mini player always at hand, quality picker and ambient light that takes colours from the video. Available on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV.

Note: your provider must support multiple simultaneous connections for this feature.

audioNoInterruptOtherApps.title: The app no longer interrupts other apps' music
audioNoInterruptOtherApps.desc: Opening KIPTV no longer pauses music or audio playing on other apps: the audio session is only activated when you actually start playing content.

vodPlaybackMoreStable.title: More stable VOD playback
vodPlaybackMoreStable.desc: Improved film and series playback: more reliable buffering management, KSPlayer engine further optimised.

playerEngineFallback.title: More resilient playback engine switching
playerEngineFallback.desc: If the playback engine you manually selected fails to start the stream, KIPTV automatically falls back to the previous one that was working, without interrupting your experience.

mylistAvailabilityCheck.title: My List: more reliable availability detection
mylistAvailabilityCheck.desc: After loading the playlist, KIPTV rechecks saved films and series via TMDB and immediately flags those that have just become available.

playlistRebuildOnPartialCache.title: Films tab empty after interrupted loading
playlistRebuildOnPartialCache.desc: Fixed a case where an interrupted playlist load left the Films tab empty.

tvosCatalogDuringPlayback.title: Apple TV: smoother browsing during playback
tvosCatalogDuringPlayback.desc: On Apple TV, catalogue updates no longer affect playback in progress, avoiding interruptions or slowdowns when watching a Live channel or a series episode.

tvosLiveAndCatchup.title: Apple TV: more reliable Live TV and catchup
tvosLiveAndCatchup.desc: Fixed an issue that could cause freezes and buffering.

playerInPlayerChannelLists.title: In-player channel list aligned with Live TV
playerInPlayerChannelLists.desc: Channel lists inside the player now follow the same order as Live TV, with special sections (Favourites, History) always within reach.

epgAutoRewriteDropboxDrive.title: EPG links from Dropbox and Google Drive
epgAutoRewriteDropboxDrive.desc: Dropbox and Google Drive sharing links now work directly as an EPG source, with no manual changes required.

mylistTmdbOnlyItemsAvailability.title: Add non-playlist content to My List
mylistTmdbOnlyItemsAvailability.desc: You can save films and series discovered via TMDB even if they aren't in your playlist yet: when they become available, KIPTV will let you know.

playlistTolerateDuplicateXtreamIds.title: Playlists with duplicate IDs
playlistTolerateDuplicateXtreamIds.desc: Fixed a crash that occurred when opening Xtream playlists containing duplicate channel or film IDs.

tvosPlayerControlsNotAuto.title: Player controls on Apple TV
tvosPlayerControlsNotAuto.desc: Fixed an issue where player controls did not auto-hide on first full-screen launch on tvOS.

tvosPlayButtonNonResponsive.title: Apple TV: Play button from search
tvosPlayButtonNonResponsive.desc: Fixed an issue where the Play button was unresponsive when opening certain titles from search results.

tvosSearchBreakQualityPickerLoop.title: Apple TV: grouped channel quality selection
tvosSearchBreakQualityPickerLoop.desc: Fixed a bug in the channel quality picker on the Search screen that caused an infinite loop when the channel was grouped with others.

supportCenterInApp.title: New in-app Support Centre
supportCenterInApp.desc: Open tickets, attach screenshots and receive replies in real time directly from the app, on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV.

triviaLoadingScreen.title: Slow connection? Here's some trivia!
triviaLoadingScreen.desc: If your connection is slow and the playlist is loading, discover fun facts about films, TV series and anime (no spoilers, promise!).

tvosRefocusChannelAfterPlayer.title: Apple TV: focus returns to the last channel
tvosRefocusChannelAfterPlayer.desc: After channel-hopping inside the player, closing it brings you right back to where you left off in the channel list.

premiumFreeTrialAllPlans.title: Free trial on all Premium plans
premiumFreeTrialAllPlans.desc: All subscription plans now offer a free trial before payment.

tvosInPlayerChannelGuide.title: Browse categories and channels in the Apple TV player
tvosInPlayerChannelGuide.desc: Browse channels and categories directly from the Live player, with smooth scrolling between carousels, without leaving the player.

playerBrightnessControl.title: Brightness control in the iOS player
playerBrightnessControl.desc: Adjust screen brightness directly from the player.

playerPinchToFill.title: Pinch to fill the screen on iOS
playerPinchToFill.desc: Fit the video with a natural gesture — pinch to zoom and fill the screen.

settingsFollowOnInstagram.title: Follow us on Instagram
settingsFollowOnInstagram.desc: New button in Settings to follow KIPTV on Instagram and stay up to date.

tvosFocusSkipFix.title: More precise focus navigation on Apple TV
tvosFocusSkipFix.desc: Circular buttons in the Apple TV player no longer skip focus unintentionally.

continueWatchingWidgets.title: Continue Watching widgets for iPhone and iPad
continueWatchingWidgets.desc: Add the new Home Screen widgets to resume films and series with a tap. Available in all sizes.

inPlayerVolumeControl.title: Volume control inside the player
inPlayerVolumeControl.desc: New volume slider directly in the player on iOS.

subtitleAppearanceInPlayer.title: Subtitle appearance directly from the player
subtitleAppearanceInPlayer.desc: Font, size and colour settings for subtitles are now in the player, accessible during playback.

myListPerTagCarousels.title: My List split by tag
myListPerTagCarousels.desc: You can now split My List into separate carousels for each tag you have assigned. Enable this in Settings > Content.

systemTimeFormat.title: Times in your system format
systemTimeFormat.desc: EPG and player now respect the 12h/24h format set in your system preferences.

tvosPipRestored.title: Picture in Picture restored on Apple TV
tvosPipRestored.desc: Picture in Picture works correctly again on tvOS after an issue introduced in a previous version.

premiumPlaylistsCap.title: Playlist limit fixed for Premium Plus users
premiumPlaylistsCap.desc: Fixed a bug where some Premium Plus users were incorrectly limited to a single playlist.

manualRotationButton.title: Rotate the player manually, whenever you like
manualRotationButton.desc: New rotation button in the iPhone player: switch between landscape and portrait with a tap, even with rotation lock on.

followOnX.title: Follow us on X
followOnX.desc: You can now follow us on X (Twitter) directly from KIPTV: find the link in Settings.

playerDragDismiss.title: Smoother player dismissal on iOS
playerDragDismiss.desc: Small tweaks to the player dismiss animation for a more natural feel.

subsResetBetweenEpisodes.title: OpenSubtitles improvements
subsResetBetweenEpisodes.desc: Refined OpenSubtitles handling for a more consistent experience between episodes.

tmdbResilience.title: Faster metadata loading
tmdbResilience.desc: Optimised film and series metadata loading for smoother browsing.

pipFixes.title: Improved Picture in Picture
pipFixes.desc: Refined the Picture in Picture experience on iPhone and Mac, with more responsive controls.

inAppFeedback.title: Help us improve KIPTV with in-app feedback
inAppFeedback.desc: You can now send us suggestions, reports and ideas directly from the app in just a few taps. We read every message and use them to improve KIPTV together with you.

playerQualityPicker.title: Switch channel quality from the player
playerQualityPicker.desc: When a Live channel has multiple qualities (HD, FHD, 4K…) you can pick the one you prefer directly from the player, without going back to the list. Available on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV.

liveInlinePreview.title: Inline live preview on Apple TV
liveInlinePreview.desc: New option in Settings > Playback: on Apple TV you can see a live preview of the highlighted channel directly in the Live TV and EPG screens, before opening fullscreen.

tmdbAmbiguousMatchPicker.title: Manual picker for multiple matches
tmdbAmbiguousMatchPicker.desc: When a title has several possible matches on TMDB, you can now choose the correct one.

liveTvQualityVariantsGrouping.title: More accurate Live TV channel grouping
liveTvQualityVariantsGrouping.desc: Improved recognition of quality variants in channel names for more reliable grouping.

memoryOomCrashFix.title: Stability with very large playlists
memoryOomCrashFix.desc: Fixed an out-of-memory crash with huge playlists and a possible EPG mix-up across different playlists.

memory.title: Crash fixes
memory.desc: Fixed an issue that caused RAM saturation on some devices, which could lead to app crashes.

player.title: Smoother player
player.desc: Reduced buffering on Live and VOD by aligning the player with AVFoundation/VLC best practices.

infoPanel.title: Player info panel
infoPanel.desc: In landscape, tap the video area above the panel to dismiss it.

tvosFocus.title: Snappier Apple TV
tvosFocus.desc: Smoother tab bar focus while navigating between sections.

badges.title: Consistent "New" badges
badges.desc: Uniform new-content indicators across Movies and Series, on both iOS and Apple TV.

trakt.title: Trakt
trakt.description: Synchronise watched status, resume points and your watchlist with your Trakt account.
trakt.intro: Link your Trakt account to keep your watch history in one place: what you watch in KIPTV goes to Trakt, and your Trakt history shows up in KIPTV on every device.
trakt.introFooter: Opt-in: nothing changes until you link an account.

trakt.scrobble: Send what you watch to Trakt
trakt.scrobbleDesc: Movies and episodes played in KIPTV go into your Trakt history.
trakt.pullWatchedDesc: Anything watched on Trakt shows as watched in KIPTV, without entering Continue Watching until you play it here.
trakt.pullPlaybackDesc: If you paused elsewhere, KIPTV resumes from there when the Trakt position is more recent.
trakt.syncWatchlistDesc: Your Trakt watchlist becomes the "Trakt Watchlist" tag in My List, in both directions.
trakt.unlinkConfirm: The watched items imported from Trakt and the Trakt Watchlist tag will be removed. What you watched in KIPTV stays.
trakt.watchlistFull: Your Trakt watchlist has reached the free account limit: the title stays only in KIPTV.

trakt.unlinkDescription: Removes the link and the data imported from Trakt; KIPTV's own watched items stay.

error.unauthorized: Trakt rejected the link: link the account again.

trakt.askRatingsDesc: After a film or an episode ends, asks for a 1 to 10 rating and sends it to Trakt.
trakt.playlistsDesc: Which playlists the integration applies to
trakt.playlistsFooter: In excluded playlists KIPTV sends nothing to Trakt and the data imported from Trakt is removed. What you watched in KIPTV stays.
